title: HDPE Containers - for Liquid Pesticides - Capacity Over 1 and up to 5 Litres
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the mechanical and physical properties and the corresponding tests for HDPE containers of nominal capacities 2, 3 and S litres intended to contain, and transport liquid pesticides.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Specification for Polyethylene Material for Moulding and Extrusion ( Third Revision )

clause_3_terminology: Capacity Over 1 and up to 5 Litres

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
